scope: Manual review of warning appropriateness on the ten tuning photos; not measured weight accuracy or independent QA.

labels.useful: Requests missing count or consumed-portion information without asserting unsupported weight error.
labels.false_alarm: The guideline is inappropriate to the visible food/count/role; this does not establish its true weight.
labels.indeterminate: A serving-range warning remains, but the photo cannot establish whether the quantity needs correction.

warnings.label: false_alarm
warnings.reason: Several scoops are visible; applying a small generic dairy single-serving upper bound to their total does not account for the multi-scoop dessert.

warnings.label: indeterminate
warnings.reason: 35 g exceeds the existing 30 g serving bound, but the visible drizzle cannot establish its mass.

warnings.label: useful
warnings.reason: Confirms the consumed amount of a shared baking dish; no cheese-sized range is applied.

warnings.label: useful
warnings.reason: No vision egg count is supplied. Requests that information without deriving count from grams.

warnings.label: useful
warnings.reason: The saved vision result has slice item type but no visible count. The new note exposes that missing count rather than inventing one from 110 g.

warnings.label: indeterminate
warnings.reason: Both the dip recipe and its mass are uncertain. A 70 g estimate versus a 60 g bound alone cannot establish a false alarm or weight error.

warnings.label: false_alarm
warnings.reason: A small garnish receives the 5 g minimum for a broad garnish serving. Its visibly minor role does not warrant a minimum-serving warning.

warnings.label: false_alarm
warnings.reason: A small garnish receives the unknown-food 10 g minimum. The guideline ignores its garnish role.

warnings.label: useful
warnings.reason: Vision requested serving confirmation. The revised message asks how much of the prepared dish was consumed, without a chicken-piece range.

warnings.label: false_alarm
warnings.reason: Four meatballs are visible and counted in the saved result, but the checker still applies an unknown-food single-serving range to their combined mass.

warnings.label: indeterminate
warnings.reason: The existing 150 g grain bound is exceeded; without a weighed portion its applicability to this rice serving is uncertain.

warnings.label: indeterminate
warnings.reason: A substantial sauce portion is visible, but neither actual grams nor recipe are measured; no reliable true/false alarm verdict.

warnings.label: useful
warnings.reason: A whole pizza is shown with a serving-confirmation flag. Asking for the consumed portion replaces a single-serving numeric warning.

removed.reason: The explicit visible count of three yields a 135-180 g range; the existing 150 g estimate falls within it.

summary.limitation: Four warnings are indeterminate; 4/9 is the rate among judged warnings only, and 4/13 is a lower bound across all warnings. Labels are subjective review by the implementing agent, not measured accuracy. No prior useful-warning labels were established by the original report.
summary.reporting_note: Report 4 of 9 judged warnings, with 4 of 13 indeterminate. This small tuning-set count is unstable: changing one label with the same denominator changes the fraction by one ninth. Do not present a stable percentage estimate.
